title: IdentityDescriptor
description: AITP v0.3 identity binding. Connects an AID to a verifiable issuer claim.

type.description: Identity mechanism. v0.3 supports: oidc, pinned_key

issuer.description: Issuer URI. Required for type=oidc; MUST be absent for type=pinned_key (RFC-AITP-0002 §1).

proof.description: Verifiable proof. For type=oidc: a compact-serialized JWT (RFC-AITP-0002 §2). For type=pinned_key: a JCS-profile signature per RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3, Ed25519 or P-256 (a p256 sender MUST use the `p256.` tag; an untagged value is Ed25519), whose input binds sender AID, receiver AID, message_id, timestamp, and the handshake pop_nonce per RFC-AITP-0002 §3.1; the pop_nonce is sourced from the handshake envelope, not from this descriptor.

public_key.description: base64url public key in the RFC-AITP-0001 §5.3 AID-identifier form: 43 chars for Ed25519, 44 chars (SEC1 compressed point) for P-256. Required for pinned_key; forbidden for oidc.

extensions.description: Optional extension namespace per RFC-AITP-0001 §7 and RFC-AITP-0012. Unknown keys inside `extensions` MUST be ignored; unknown fields outside it are rejected by this schema.
